summary: Alumni Network Phase 1 MVP — full backend + frontend validation. All 17 backend tests passed (public stats, me, register dup, update profile, profile-by-id, search, tree, relations, invites). Frontend landing page, onboarding (step-3 redirect for registered users), tree (9 members, tabs, node click side panel, Mark modal with search), and profile (badges, streak, XP, chain) all rendered correctly. Seed data for student1 -> ภูมิ with full 5 ancestors + 3 descendants verified exactly as spec.

issues: How-it-works cards and testimonials lack individual data-testid (only 'testimonial-*' found). Stats section lacks data-testid='alumni-stats-section'. Not blocking but hampers fine-grained automated testing.
Side panel (opened on node click) has no role='dialog' nor a stable data-testid such as 'tree-side-panel'. Works visually but harder to assert programmatically.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Add data-testid='alumni-stats-section', 'how-it-works-card-N' and 'testimonial-N' to the landing page sections so they align with the review-request testids.
(Optional, minor) Add role='dialog' + data-testid='tree-side-panel' to the tree node side panel for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 11769 lines — violates file-size guideline (>700 lines). Recommend continuing to split into feature routers (alumni.py already factored out — good pattern).

alumni.py BFS helpers issue a separate DB query per frontier node (_confirmed_parents/_confirmed_children inside loops). For small trees OK, but at scale this is O(N) queries. Consider batched $in queries when tree grows.
alumni.py register uses current_user.full_name.split()[0] for default nickname — will crash with AttributeError if full_name is None or empty. Add a null guard.
GET /alumni/stats new_today computation uses ISO string comparison on 'created_at' — works only because seed uses ISO. If legacy records have datetime objects, comparison becomes unreliable.
No rate-limiting/permission on /alumni/profile/{user_id}; any authenticated user can fetch any profile. Acceptable for MVP but should be revisited with privacy_settings enforcement in Phase 2.
